definition: לָחֶם noun [masculine] only in אָז לָחֶ֣ם שְׁעָרִים Judg 5:8 (so Masora; Manuscripts לָחֵ֣ם , לָחֶ֣ם ), usually translated then was there war of ( = at) the gates , but improbable; text and meaning dubious; A ᵐ5 L read is ὡς ἄρτον κρίθινον , whence Bu RS 103 אָז לֶחֶם שְׂעֹרִים then they used to eat barley bread ; but Bu Comm. {abbrev } שׂ ׳ אָזַל ל the barley bread was exhausted ; Mayer Lambert RŠJ xxx, 115 אז לחמשׁ ערים then for (in) 5 cities no shield was seen, etc.; other conjectures in Kau AT ; compare GFM on the passage
